attributes.board_name: Mississippi State Board of Dental Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by ADA, AGD, Mississippi Dental Association, Mississippi Dental Society, NDA, NDHA, MDHA, ADHA, AADB or the Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure, or approved by the Board course by course; BLS/ACLS/PALS hours count (caps 8/16/16)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt during the first biennial renewal period.
rules.audit_note: Licensee certifies compliance at renewal and uploads proof to the CE tracking system (CE Broker); random audit after each period; keep records 3 years. Fines from $500 (first offense).

topics.who: Dentists who prescribe, administer or dispense controlled substances in Mississippi
Current CPR (AHA, Red Cross, ACLS or PALS with hands-on component)

rules.notes: Period Jan 1 of even year to Dec 31 of odd year. Up to 20 h for passing an ADA specialty board recertification exam. Online/correspondence courses allowed if they include a post-study exam. Current CPR certification (AHA, Red Cross, ACLS or PALS with hands-on component) required under Board Regulation 45.
rules.legal_basis: 30 Miss. Admin. Code Pt. 2301, R. 1.41 (Board Regulation 41)
rules.rule_quote: Dentists must obtain a minimum of forty (40) hours of continuing education for the two-year cycle, and dental hygienists must obtain a minimum of twenty (20) hours of continuing education for the two-year cycle.
